skeleton.$description: Skeleton: the shape of what is loading (lines of text, a block, a circle), until it is there.

animation.$description: How it moves when not told: wave, pulse, none.

duration.$description: One wave or pulse; follows the motion durations, so reduced motion keeps it still.

wave-mix.$description: How much of the bone's colour the wave mixes in at its brightest (a percentage).

pulse-dim.$description: The opacity a pulse fades the bone to.

line-height.$description: The height of a line of text.

last-line.$description: How much of the width the last of several lines takes (a percentage).

bone.$description: One shape: `text` (a line), `rect` (a block), `circle`. Its `color` is the colour the wave and the pulse mix in.
